waves.summary: Wave 1 finished the ladder analysis of all 228 games (we won 120): having more total length at round 100 predicted the result (79–33 when ahead, 35–73 when behind), and our dragons die by their own move with an enemy head nearby about twice as often per unit as the opponents'. That second number is the main lead, so the queue's first test, H1, is a new off-by-default toggle (`TR_PRESS_ROOM`) aimed at it. H2 (an existing threat-reach setting) is queued next, and H3 (splitting more in the midgame) was dropped without any games because we already split more often than the opponents.
